recentItems.title: Is it legal to go topless in Canada?
recentItems.description:
Nineteen-year-old Gwen Jacob is just trying to catch a breeze when she goes topless during a 1991 heat wave. But after being cat-called and arrested, her simple attempt to stay cool turns into a statement. And when she refuses to pay her fine, she ends up in a court battle that triggers a nationwide debate about sexism, safety and control over women’s bodies.

Host Falen Johnson and journalist Clare Bonnyman detail the multi-year saga of R. vs. Jacob, a case that challenged and eventually changed how the law treats women who bare their breasts.

recentItems.title: Protest erupts as Carney's investment summit kicks off
recentItems.description:

Carney invited 100 top investors from around the world in the hopes of securing $1 trillion in investments in some 167 projects across the country over the next five years.
